# pushsecurity_employee (Data Source)

Looks up a single employee by email address, for use in an `employee_ids` criterion.

Fails if the email matches no employee, so a typo is caught during plan rather than narrowing a control to nobody.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single employee, by email. Fails during plan if the address matches no
# employee, so a typo cannot silently narrow a control to nobody.
data "pushsecurity_employee" "security_lead" {
  email = "security.lead@example.com"
}

output "security_lead_groups" {
  value = data.pushsecurity_employee.security_lead.groups
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The employee's email address, compared ignoring case. Must match exactly one employee.

### Read-Only

- `chatops_enabled` (Boolean) Whether ChatOps is enabled for the employee.
- `department` (String) The employee's department.
- `first_name` (String) The employee's first name.
- `groups` (Set of String) The groups the employee belongs to, as used by the `employee_groups` criterion.
- `id` (String) The employee identifier the API stores internally. Control criteria are written with email addresses, which the provider resolves, so this is informational.
- `last_name` (String) The employee's last name.
- `licensed` (Boolean) Whether the employee holds a licence.
- `location` (String) The employee's location.
